claims.quote: Hoplisoma petracinii, long known as Corydoras petracinii, is an armoured catfish known only from one ephemeral stream in the Río San Lorenzo watershed of Salta province, Argentina.
Known only from a single locality in the Lomas de Medeiros hills, Río San Lorenzo watershed, Salta province, northwestern Argentina.
